$comment: languages-world-1 (10 November 2026): the WhatsApp allergen guard’s trigger words for INDONESIAN (id-ID): alergi / alergen, intoleran, tidak tahan laktosa, seliak, anafilaksis, bebas / tanpa <allergen>, nggak / gak / tidak pakai (pake), tidak mengandung, aman untuk / bagi / buat, cocok untuk, mungkin / bisa / dapat mengandung, kontaminasi silang, jejak, sensitif. "ga pakai" is NOT a stem (it is inside "harga pakai"). OPTION B, as every other language: absence / safety words only, NOT the bare allergen names (a presence question may reach the AI, which answers only from the tags and gets the caveat). Matched with the Unicode normaliser. caveatWords: a tagged label of the codex allergen set (stored in English, lower case) → the words a reply may use for it (matched on the raw lower-cased reply, so written as the AI writes them). The country has no allergen set of its own yet, so caveatWords are for 'codex' (as MX, SG, HK, MY, TH and AE).
